summary: Release host-local suspension snapshots after durable native-session resume verification, and sweep unreferenced snapshot entries before reconciliation starts after a restart. Preserve manual holds, in-flight operations and failed resumes. Fence reclamation with atomic renames under the writer, then delete trash outside the writer in entry- and time-bounded batches.

replay.detail: Uses existing suspension projections and operation receipts.

compatibility.detail: No protocol changes; older snapshots are handled by the existing projection.

downtime.detail: No restart required beyond normal daemon rollout.

recovery.detail: Unreferenced host-local suspension archives are reclaimed at restart. Interrupted reclamation leaves isolated trash that the next restart finishes. Authoritative native sessions and workspaces are not removed.
